errors.description: The LLM chose a query that was too specific, preventing the retrieval of any relevant information about the video and the bird species count.

errors.evidence: After receiving irrelevant search results, the agent failed to identify that no useful data was returned and continued searching, never extracting a valid count.
errors.description: The system misinterpreted the lack of relevant results as a signal to continue searching rather than acknowledging the failure and adjusting strategy.

errors.description: The agent repeatedly invoked the web_search tool with identical parameters, unnecessarily consuming resources.

errors.description: The agent ignored the instruction that the final answer must contain multiple sections and thus failed to comply with the task specification.
